Eye Pattern - Glowing Eyes.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Glowing Eyes
Eyes that emit a soft luminescence — irises that appear to glow from within, shedding faint light in dim conditions.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Glowing Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both eyes emit a visible glow — the irises are lit from within, each radiating light in its selected color. Apply glowing iris effect to both eyes using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
